raw_posts.name: Wizstar R1
raw_posts.tagline: Seedance 2.0-level product videos at a lower cost
raw_posts.description: Wizstar R1 is an in-house AI video model built for affordable, everyday creation. Combine up to nine reference images and videos to generate 5–15-second videos with native audio, guided by your products, characters, scenes, and styles. R1 excels at animation and 3D content and matches Seedance 2.0's usable-output rate for product videos in internal tests. Eligible members enjoy unlimited, credit-free generation, giving creators more freedom to experiment and refine their ideas.

raw_posts.name: Depost AI
raw_posts.tagline: The LinkedIn AI agent that learns what works for your brand
raw_posts.description: Depost AI scores every LinkedIn post you've published against your own average, finds what's winning in your niche, then plans the month, writes in your voice, and designs the graphics. You approve every post, and it publishes through LinkedIn's official API. It also drafts replies to the conversations worth joining, so posts turn into leads—works in the app, or inside Claude and ChatGPT over MCP.

raw_posts.name: Contral
raw_posts.tagline: The AI coding agent that checks its work and teaches you
raw_posts.description: Contral is out of beta. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI or Copilot CLI inside Contral, on your own account. Contral checks every turn against what you asked for and sends smaller models a specific correction, explains every change with a teaching card, and undoes a whole turn in one click. Plus Defense Mode, video explanations by Scrimba, and Learn mode in 5 languages. In VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf and more, or the Contral IDE. Free to start.

raw_posts.name: Periscope
raw_posts.tagline: Turn any work into an API
raw_posts.description: Describe a task and get an endpoint for it. An agent does the work through the screen on its own cloud desktop, in any software, however old. Call it over REST, or from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor over MCP. The Free plan needs no card.

raw_posts.name: Pushary Calls
raw_posts.tagline: Miss your AI agent’s ping? Pushary calls you.
raw_posts.description: Your AI agent stops to ask before it does anything big. If you're at lunch, it sits there until you're back. Pushary sends the question to your phone. Miss it, and Pushary calls you. You hear what the agent wants and say yes, no, or what to do instead. Then it keeps working. Calls only ring in hours you pick. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Hermes and more.

raw_posts.name: RightFont 2026
raw_posts.description: RightFont 2026 is rebuilt from the ground up for a smarter, faster and more intuitive font management experience. Preview and apply fonts directly in your designs, discover fonts with on-device AI, share libraries effortlessly, and clean up duplicates with Font Insights. Built for speed, even with 200,000 fonts. Spend less time managing fonts and more time creating.

raw_posts.description: The biggest Espresso ever. A new look for macOS 27, an AI that builds across your whole site without a line of it leaving your Mac, and an editor with far more under the hood.
